SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) AS m, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) l0, max(etl_loaded_at) l1, sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wb, sum(gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-10' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, s.store_id = 999 AS is_train, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, o.status, f.vat_rate,
  count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(f.net_amount) nt,
  sum(abs(f.gross_amount - round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2))>0.02) AS vat_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) aug_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT s.region, s.store_id,
           CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
           f.sale_date AS order_date, f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END),2) AS aug_2024,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END),2) AS sep_2024,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END),2) AS aug_orderdate,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END),2) AS sep_orderdate,
  count(DISTINCT store_id) stores, sum(CASE WHEN business_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_dates
FROM lines GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
